units.source_text: 悲秋虽非我一人之事，但……”

en.t: It is not only I who grieves over autumn, but..."

units.source_text: 说罢泪下如雨，毕竟觉得不好意思，连忙以扇遮面。

en.t: Having said this, tears fell from her like rain; feeling embarrassed after all, she hurriedly covered her face with her fan.

units.source_text: 匂亲王推量她的心情，也觉得很可怜。

en.t: Prince Niou guessed what she must be feeling, and he too found her deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 但猜疑终是不释，他想：“正因为此人如此惹人怜爱，只恐那人不会放弃她呢。”

en.t: Yet his suspicions would not leave him, and he thought, "Precisely because she is so lovable and pitiful, I fear that man will not give her up."

units.source_text: 便觉妒火中烧，不胜痛恨。

en.t: Then he felt the fire of jealousy burning within him, and was overcome with bitter resentment.
